tests/interfaces/store/test_reducer_single_source.py:45: `rebar.link(tid, epic, "relates_to", repo_root=r)` — the only link in _rich_ticket is OUTGOING from tid; nothing links INTO tid, so tid's inbound_deps is [] independent of the include_inbound flag
test_show_inbound_deps.py contains no invocation of `show --output llm`; all _cli_show calls use the default (json) format (test_show_inbound_deps.py:22-30)
Ticket 05cb progress comment: 'The --output llm arm is deliberately left inbound-free ... recorded as a residual gap.'
advisory.finding: The `--output llm` arm's inbound-free contract (`include_inbound=fmt != "llm"`, new in reads_cli.py) has no test that can actually catch a regression: the cited guard test_llm_parity_show_vs_list uses a fixture (_rich_ticket) whose shown ticket has only an OUTGOING relates_to link and no inbound edges, so its inbound_deps is [] whether or not the llm arm sets include_inbound=True. A change causing the llm arm to leak inbound_deps would leave both that parity test and the new tests green. No test in test_show_inbound_deps.py exercises `show --output llm` on a ticket WITH an inbound edge to assert the key is absent.
scenarios: A future refactor of the fmt/include_inbound wiring lets the llm arm compute inbound_deps; the show↔list llm parity contract silently breaks with no failing test.
advisory.suggested_fix: In test_show_inbound_deps.py, add a case that builds an A --blocks--> B pair and asserts `inbound_deps` (and its llm short key `ibl`) is absent from `rebar show --output llm B` output, while the default view for B includes it.
